capabilities: set overall word count goals on notes and folders
set daily goals that reset each day
run timed sprint goals with start, pause, edit and reset
view goal progress in real time and as bar chart stats in a single view
exclude notes from contributing to folder word counts
extras: Shares the default word-goal frontmatter property name with the Novel word count plugin; uses undocumented duck typing to access the File Explorer pane, so major Obsidian updates may temporarily break it, though it is designed to fail gracefully.
intentEvidence: This plugin provides a simplified version of a goals feature available in Ulysses.
motivation: The author built it as a simplified version of the goals feature available in the Ulysses writing app.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to set word count targets for individual notes or folders and track progress toward them.

relations.evidence: a simplified version of a goals feature available in Ulysses
whose Better Word Count plugin helped me resolve some language specific word count issues

summary: Word-count goal tracker for notes and folders, with daily and timed sprint goals plus real-time progress bars and stats.
